text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —...Haa... haa... ngh.
choice_data_list: We grew stronger because we admired you.

We grew stronger because we looked up to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Cut it out.
choice_data_list: You're the one who made us strong.
You're the one who made us strong.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't go adding unnecessary backstories! 
Not for me, and not for any of you 
either—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're a star that can shine bright 
without anyone else, damn it!
choice_data_list:
You're the kind of person who could say 
that, and that's why I looked up to you!!

You're the kind of person who could say 
that, and that's why I looked up to you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what others said or thought 
about her, Sirius Symboli acted solely on 
her own assessment of herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She continued to carry herself with noble 
grace, refusing to be swayed by others and 
remaining true to none other than herself.
choice_data_list: ...We want to be like you too.
...We want to become like you too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she were chosen to represent Japan 
again this year, if she were to lose at 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While there will be voices praising me, 
there'll likely be backlash too. However—
choice_data_list:
No matter what voices come my way, I won't 
waver—just like you.

No matter what voices come my way, I won't 
waver—just like you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Toward that single goal that is mine 
alone, I will keep moving forward on these 
legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...If you're gonna talk that big, show me 
what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head high enough to silence 
everyone else. Continue to reign as the 
victor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The announcement of Japan's representative 
team is about to—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Mei. I will withdraw from consideration 
for the Japan representative.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Withdrawing... as in giving up? No 
way... Sirius-san's results were so good, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Silence, everyone. ...Are you certain 
about this, Sirius Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm only stepping down as the 
representative candidate. I will still 
accompany the overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Assign me to support the ones chosen as 
representatives.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we shall select Japan's 
representative from the candidates, 
excluding Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: First up is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Those guys will definitely make the 
representative team.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on to that stubborn pride you 
showed me, all the way to the very end.
